title: Amrti Churna
description: Amrti Churna (Amritadi Churna) features Giloy (Amrita) and skin-cleansing roots as its base for comprehensive blood purification. This classical formulation purifies blood streams by removing accumulated toxins. Significantly reduces elevated serum uric acid levels preventing gout. Manages chronic joint aches through improved circulation.
